reason: An unaided reading of line 2 as allegations of Qui satisdare cogantur and De procuratoribus matched nothing; with the printed gloss at hand the same letters read "-nque. §. quod si servus. et de hiis", which fits the gloss on illatae sunt line for line.

text:
Source-assisted reading of F-18n8 (Leuven, KU Leuven, Ms. 1033), strip 1 "recto". All six lines were reread on the image by a research reader with the printed Accursian gloss on "illatae sunt" (D. 4.9.1.8; Paris 1566, col. 663, gloss h) at hand; an earlier reading of line 2 made without the source ("qui satisdare ... de procuratoribus") was wrong and is replaced here. Accuracy has not been measured.
